_about: Tenant registry for Trackfoots multi-tenancy. One tenant = one `node server.js` process with its own PORT, WITNESS_DATA, INGEST_KEY and ORG. There are no shared rows, no shared chain sequence namespace, and no shared auditor store.
_shape: { "tenants": [ { "name": string, "port": int 1024-65535, "org": string, "dataDir": string relative to repo root, "keyEnv": string env var holding this tenant's ingest key } ] }
